4 اقمأت المَاشِيَةُ : see 1, first sentence. ―
-b2- اقمأ القَوْمُ The people, or party, had their camels in a fat, or plump, state. (S, O, K.) ―
-b3- اقمأ المَرْعَى الإِبِلَ The pasture, or place of pasture, suited the camels, (K, TA,) and rendered them fat, or plump. (TA, as from the K.) And اقمأهُ It (a thing, S, O, or a place, or pasture or a place of pasture, TA) pleased him. (S, O, K, TA.) ＝
-A2- And اقمأهُ He rendered him little and despicable. (S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
